definitions.explanation: A map showing only outlines such as borders and coastlines, with place names and other details left blank. Used in geography classes for students to fill in.

examples.japanese: {白地図|はくちず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{県名|けんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{込|こ}む→書き込む：04599_kakikomu⟧。
examples.english: I fill in the prefecture names on a blank map.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白地図|はくちず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: For homework, I wrote the river names onto a blank map of Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白地図|はくちず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}り→配る：03921_kubaru⟧、⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えさせた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher handed out blank maps and had us memorize the locations of the world's countries.

notes:
Composed of {白|はく} (blank, white) + ⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧ (map). A standard tool in geography education.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白地図|はくちず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}き{込|こ}む→書き込む：04599_kakikomu⟧: to fill in a blank map
- {白地図|はくちず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧: to hand out blank maps

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧: map — the general word; a {白地図|はくちず} is a map with the labels removed
